#!/bin/bash
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/gt/ruby:\$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
export GEM_HOME=/gt/ruby/gems
export GEM_PATH=/gt/ruby/gems
exec /gt/ruby/bin/ruby3.2 "\$@"
